1.consolidated_definition: Pavonearse. Exhibirse una persona haciendo gala de su ropa y de su garbo de petimetre.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To preen oneself. To display oneself as a person showing off one's clothes and affected elegance characteristic of a dandy.
